name: Civil unrest
summary: France's 5 Nov strike drew 575,000 by official count; security operation against protest camps in Pakistani Kashmir
state: France's Interior Ministry counted 575,000 marchers on the 5 Nov national strike and the CGT union nearly 1.6 million; Lyon's prefecture reported 40 injured, and no deaths were reported (Euronews). Unions and employers meet the government on 9 Nov. Security forces moved against protest camps in Rawalakot, Pakistan-administered Kashmir, on 5 Nov, with deaths reported, and the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan urged talks (Outlook India). That report could not be corroborated on 8 Nov, so an Alert for a state crackdown is unconfirmed.
for_you: Travellers and commuters in French cities may meet disruption on protest days. French official sources and FCDO travel advice cover current conditions for visitors.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant protests in France and deadly unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir. Alert line (deadly nationwide unrest or crackdown in a major country) unconfirmed.

sources.title: Euronews — En France, une journée de grève nationale à l'appel des organisations syndicales

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
